title: E1 — Water inlet failure (4 min fill)

source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-DWR3SS1 Top Control Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect the power supply to the dishwasher.

steps.title: E1 behavior
steps.body: E1 logs when the flow meter cannot detect defined water within 4 minutes during the inlet step. OCR may show El — treat as E1.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If the flow meter can't detect the defined water after 4 minutes, the dishwasher will warning for E1.

steps.title: Water supply and installation
steps.body: Verify supply valve on, adequate pressure, inlet screen clean, drain hose not siphoning, and dishwasher level.

steps.title: Bench fill path
steps.body: Power off. Access kick panel. Inspect CON3 inlet harness, flow meter at CN4, pressure switch hose, and drain path. Run fill-valve ohms test (nsdwr3ss1-fill-valve) and drain pump test if sump retains water.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Access kick panel. Inspect CON3 inlet harness, flow meter at CN4, pressure switch hose, and drain path. Run fill-valve ohms test (nsdwr3ss1-fill-valve) and drain pump test if sump retains water.

steps.title: Pressure switch hose and tubing
steps.body: Pressure switch hose runs from switch to sump via air breaker. Hose kinked, disconnected, or blocked?

steps.title: Flow meter and CN4
steps.body: Inspect CN4 flow meter / flood detection harness for damage or poor connection at main PCB.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect CN4 flow meter / flood detection harness for damage or poor connection at main PCB.

steps.title: Correct supply issue
steps.body: Restore water supply, correct installation, and retest fill.
steps.oemOutcome: Restore water supply, correct installation, and retest fill.

steps.title: Repair pressure switch path
steps.body: Repair or replace pressure switch hose; verify switch seated in base bracket.
steps.oemOutcome: Repair or replace pressure switch hose; verify switch seated in base bracket.

steps.title: Fill path verified
steps.body: Supply, inlet valve, flow meter, pressure switch, and drain prerequisites checked — retest for E1.
steps.oemOutcome: Supply, inlet valve, flow meter, pressure switch, and drain prerequisites checked — retest for E1.
